title: HUMAN LIFESPAN DEVELOPMENT
description: Provides an in-depth analysis of a variety of topics related to developmental psychology introduced in lower-division coursework. Explores physical, social/emotional, and cognitive human development from conception through late adulthood and death from a psychological science perspective. Emphasizes critical evaluation of empirical research and theoretical models beyond the introductory level in developmental psychology.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (PSY 201, 201H, 201Z or 201HZ) and (PSY 202, 202H, 202Z or 202HZ).
A minimum grade of C- is required in PSY 201, PSY 201H, PSY 201Z, PSY 201HZ, PSY 202, PSY 202H, PSY 202Z and PSY 202HZ.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.
